items.title: Why PFE Stock Hands You So Much Cash Right Now
items.summary: The market is pricing in an unusually high cash-generation yield for one of the world's largest drugmakers, forcing investors to decide if the price reflects a temporary problem or a permanent decline.

items.title: Strong Earnings Power Dow to Another Record
items.summary: A new round of strong earnings reports powered the Dow Jones Industrial Average to a fresh high on Wednesday, underscoring how surging profits are underpinning the stock-market rally.  Upbeat reports from  Amgen Walt Disney  and Merck helped send the blue-chip index 0.5%, or 263 points, higher to 54349.  The Dow industrials have now climbed for five straight sessions, notching three straight records and a 5.3% gain in their best such run since the volatile days of the April 2025 tariff panic.

items.title: Merck (MRK) Is Racing Beyond Keytruda As Its Biggest Patent Cliff Nears
items.summary: Merck (NYSE:MRK) is approaching a major patent cliff for cancer drug Keytruda from 2028. The company is increasing acquisitions and partnerships to broaden its portfolio beyond oncology. Merck is building pipelines in areas such as hematology, infectious diseases, cardiopulmonary, vaccines, and obesity. items.title: GILD Q2 Earnings Beat on HIV and Trodelvy Growth, Product Sales Outlook Raised
items.summary: GILD beats Q2 revenue estimates as HIV sales fuel growth, while acquisition charges cause a loss. Higher HIV guidance and pipeline progress support momentum.

items.title: Prediction: AbbVie Will End The Year at This Price
items.summary: AbbVie's blockbuster drugs are surging while a major acquisition looms, but a trailing P/E of 71 and one model pricing the stock nearly $50 below current levels raises a real question about whether the rally has room left to run.

items.title: MRK Q2 Earnings Call Puts Pipeline Progress in Focus
